mean_delay_s.label: Mean delay
mean_delay_s.definition: Mean SUMO tripinfo timeLoss of arrived non-emergency vehicles: time lost versus driving at the desired speed (includes waiting at signals).

mean_travel_time_s.label: Mean travel time
mean_travel_time_s.definition: Mean tripinfo duration (arrival - departure) of arrived non-emergency vehicles.

stops_per_vehicle.label: Stops per vehicle
stops_per_vehicle.definition: Mean tripinfo waitingCount of arrived non-emergency vehicles (number of times speed fell below 0.1 m/s).

mean_total_delay_all_s.label: Mean total delay, all vehicles
mean_total_delay_all_s.definition: Mean of tripinfo timeLoss + departDelay over ALL non-emergency vehicles that departed, including vehicles still en route at the end (SUMO write-unfinished values, censored at the run end, i.e. a lower bound for them). Same denominator for every controller of a cell; the primary delay metric when arrived counts differ.

mean_queue_veh.label: Mean network queue (demand period)
mean_queue_veh.definition: Mean of the network-wide halting-vehicle count (speed < 0.1 m/s, all lanes, every 1 s step) over the demand period [demand begin, demand end] - the same time window for every controller.

max_queue_veh.label: Max network queue
max_queue_veh.definition: Maximum over all steps of the run of the network-wide halting-vehicle count.

halted_vehicle_hours.label: Halted vehicle-hours
halted_vehicle_hours.definition: Sum over all steps of the network-wide halting-vehicle count × step length / 3600 (whole run; censored at the cap for timed-out runs).

arrived_share.label: Arrived share
arrived_share.definition: Arrived non-emergency vehicles / loaded non-emergency vehicles.

arrived_vehicles.label: Arrived vehicles
arrived_vehicles.definition: Non-emergency vehicles that reached their destination before the end of the run (throughput).

unfinished_vehicles.label: Unfinished vehicles
unfinished_vehicles.definition: Vehicles loaded but not arrived when the run ended (still driving, waiting to insert, or removed).

fuel_g_per_vehicle.label: Fuel per vehicle
fuel_g_per_vehicle.definition: Total fuel from SUMO's default emission model (summed per step for all vehicles) / vehicles observed. Not valid for the mixed-traffic stage (one passenger-car model for all types).

teleports.label: Teleports
teleports.definition: SUMO teleports (vehicles removed after being stuck for time-to-teleport): a simulation failure indicator.

decision_latency_ms.label: Decision latency (mean)
decision_latency_ms.definition: Swarm controllers only: wall time of one decision tick for the whole network (observe, optimise every junction, coordinate, gate, apply).

optimizer_ms.label: Optimizer time per decision
optimizer_ms.definition: Swarm controllers only: mean wall time of one PSO+ACO optimizer call.

sim_wall_time_s.label: Simulation runtime
sim_wall_time_s.definition: Wall-clock time of the run (SUMO + controller), on the machine and parallel load of the matrix run.

ambulance_travel_time_s.label: Ambulance travel time
ambulance_travel_time_s.definition: Mean tripinfo duration of the run's ambulances (emergency stage).

ambulance_delay_s.label: Ambulance delay
ambulance_delay_s.definition: Mean tripinfo timeLoss of the run's ambulances (emergency stage).

prediction_online_mae.label: Online prediction MAE
prediction_online_mae.definition: swarm_prediction only: mean absolute error of the controller's own one-step-ahead per-phase queue predictions, checked online against the later observation.

prediction_online_rmse.label: Online prediction RMSE
prediction_online_rmse.definition: As the MAE, root mean squared error.

prediction_fallback_share.label: Prediction fallback share
prediction_fallback_share.definition: Share of predict calls in which the predictor was not reliable yet (rolling MAE above max_mae, or too few checks), so the controller used the current state.

config.name: eval-v1
config.description: Initial validation matrix. Every cell (stage, network, scenario, seed) runs all of the stage's controllers on ONE prepared scenario: identical network, route file, demand seed and SUMO seed. demand_seed = seed, so seeds also vary the generated demand.

core.description: Three-controller comparison on generated grids, all scenarios (road-closure = real SUMO closingReroute).

ablation.description: Swarm module ablations (the safety gate is never disabled).

emergency.description: Ambulance priority vs the same controller without priority (3 ambulances per run).

mixed.description: Indian mixed traffic (assumed mix) on a left-hand 5x5 grid with pedestrians, and the Bengaluru OSM sample.

notes: Preliminary simulation results; significance is not proof of real-world benefit.
Holm correction per stage; see report.md for the method and limitations.
